Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi20PlantExportMetadata

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi20PlantExportMetadata
public final class Dexpi20PlantExportMetadata extends Object
Immutable, caller-supplied provenance and plant identity for a native DEXPI 2.0 Plant exchange.

The export timestamp and plant identity are deliberately required inputs. The exporter never invents a current timestamp or project metadata, and use of this class does not imply drawing approval or DEXPI qualification.
